statement: The common signed-base lookup implementation passes 27 feature tests locally. New checks cover both signs of every depth-four base point on both toy curves, all five historical F127 target-in-base refusals in the fixed 12-draw prefix, a missing-oracle miss retained as undetermined, and rejection of altered lookup policy/count accounting. Unflagged Direct still recovers with nine queries. These are unsigned development checks, not a new map or performance conclusion.
